title: Eigenfunctions and Eigenvalues
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the eigenfunctions and eigenvalues for the infinite square well potential.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply first-order perturbation theory correctly to find the energy shifts for excited states.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the probability of finding the particle in the first and second excited states at a later time.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that the eigenfunctions are properly normalized.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly evaluate the integrals involved in the perturbation calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect limits in integrals.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must present final answers clearly and in the correct format.
